gen-dm-serif-text-gf-lexend-peta: DM Serif Text opens with chunky downstrokes and threadlike crossbars. Lexend Peta, in sans-serif form, keeps every curve unthinned, so the heading supplies the drama and the body supplies the plain, wide-mouthed steadiness.
gen-dm-serif-text-gf-lexend-tera: Lexend Tera reads wide and open, drawn like a plotter pen. DM Serif Text brings heavy strokes that nearly vanish at the turns, and the two trade weight against spacing without crowding each other.
gen-dm-serif-text-gf-lexend-zetta: Heavy downstrokes joined by hairline connectors give DM Serif Text its rhythm, while Lexend Zetta runs in ribbon-like, widely tracked lines. Give the heading extra size.
gen-dm-serif-text-gf-montserrat-alternat: Montserrat Alternates reads tall and chalky, its rounded letters crowding toward the capital line. DM Serif Text sits above it, so a long page feels like bookish heft over a tight, rounded hum.
gen-eater-fs-gambetta: Eater looks scratchy and menacing, with thin strokes and gaps between letters. Gambetta's serif lines swell gently into wide counters, so a long page settles into a graceful, bookish pace after the heading's snarl.
gen-eater-gf-abyssinica-sil: Abyssinica SIL reads literary, its line weight shifting like brushed watercolor across tall middle zones. Eater counters it with a dark, aggressive display voice, spaced wide and short in the ascenders.
gen-eater-gf-cambo: Cambo is a refined serif, with a short step from lowercase to capital and a modest thick-thin rhythm. And Eater's dark, jagged display character is the pair's strongest quality, set against that bookish restraint.
gen-eater-gf-fanwood-text: Fanwood Text has a large-eyed lowercase and gently swelling curves, tiny gaps vanishing at a glance. Fanwood Text lets the eye glide along a long page, while Eater's aggressive heading supplies the bite.
gen-eater-gf-holtwood-one-sc: Eater's thin strokes and wide letter gaps give it a dark, aggressive snarl. It is best at menace; Holtwood One SC is best at towering, wide-tracked authority.
gen-eater-gf-manuale: Manuale reads traditional and editorial, with a large-eyed lowercase and moderate contrast that keeps long lines easy to follow. Its strongest quality is steady restraint against Eater's menace.
